# OpenDesign UI/UX Generator (DeepSeek Integration)
Upstream Specification: 402-First Open Design Protocol

## Overview
Automated design system, wireframe, and token generator built for AI agents and human design teams.
Integrated into AIFoundry.sh as `/v1/tools/design.402`.

## Core Outputs
- Color tokens (hex palette)
- Typography hierarchy (Space Grotesk, Inter, JetBrains Mono)
- Component spec lists (Paywall Modal, Budget Gauges, Code Playgrounds)
- Brand logo concept & SVG layouts
